failure: A production Mother replaced the user and coordinator-approved method with an unrequested simplification or alternative pipeline.

incident.approvedNextStep: one-to-one high-dimensional functional expression following Mother coordinator instructions
unauthorizedDetour: surface projection used as a substitute for one-to-one expression
incident.rootCause: Executor acted as a method inventor and direction decision-maker instead of an execution platform.

mustNeverRepeat: introducing a new method without explicit user or coordinator authorization
reinterpreting one-to-one expression as a lower-fidelity proxy
adding simplification, remeshing, voxelization, LOD or replacement dependencies by default
using industry convention as permission to change the frozen task
continuing to produce versions after the foundational direction is known to be wrong
presenting a clone, material swap, copied topology or loaded teacher asset as independent functional reconstruction

motherCoordinatorOwns: permission to enter the next stage
productionMotherOwns: experiments explicitly required by the task

requiredBehavior.whenMethodIsClear: execute continuously without asking the user to repeat continue
requiredBehavior.whenMethodIsUnclear: stop at the current boundary and ask the Mother coordinator before changing the pipeline
requiredBehavior.whenAChoiceChangesFidelityOrMeaning: treat it as a method decision and escalate
requiredBehavior.whenAChoiceOnlyImplementsTheFrozenMethod: make the narrow technical choice, test it, and report evidence

invalidDefaultActions: static image or mockup substituted for an interactive 3D artifact
local or sandbox file substituted for the required direct-open public page
violationResponse: exclude it from baseline, evidence, handoff and training material
return to the last approved baseline
record the regression for all Mothers
resume only under the coordinator-approved method
